title: RIKEN second notice: figures and credentials updated
what_changed: Summary now follows RIKEN's second notice of 20 Nov: 4,222 Fugaku users affected, 430 credentials taken (233 SSH keys without passphrase, 197 with), connections to external systems confirmed for some. records_affected changed from 4597 to 4222 because the notice does not state the Rikyu count.
